messages:
Jess (Sales): Quick handoff for AtriaHealth — closed: 1yr Reserved Dedicated + Private (VPC) with PHI connector. Target go-live ~6w.
Jess (Sales): Main customer contacts: erin@atriahealth.com (IT lead), vishal@atriahealth.com (product). Note: pilot funding may be cut if rollout slips >8w — renewal risk flagged.
Jess (Sales): Primary asks: Okta SSO, VPC peering, and an API adapter with server-side PHI redaction.
Maria (CS): On it. I'll run kickoff doc + timeline and own onboarding. Planning initial runbook call.
Maria (CS): Immediate blockers: 1) IdP metadata + cert exchange, 2) peering CIDR + firewall rules, 3) KMS policy & data classification.
Alex (Support): Adding eng for the connector — @Sam can you rough-estimate adapter + redaction hook effort?
Sam (Eng): Need schema + sample payloads + staging endpoint. If auth is straightforward, estimate ~2 sprints for adapter + tests.
Priya (Enablement): I'll prepare two enablement sessions: Admin ops (SSO/VPC) and Dev ops (connector + logs). Also a short pre-recorded SSO walkthrough to send to Erin.
Maria (CS): Owners (initial):
- Onboarding plan & timeline: Maria
- SSO certs / IdP exchange: Erin (customer) / Alex (Support) to verify
- VPC peering & infra: Sam (Eng) + infra ticket
- Connector dev & PHI redaction: Sam (Eng)
- Enablement & runbooks: Priya
- Renewal watch & customer coms: Jess (Sales)
Jess (Sales): Please alert renewal team if adoption signals are weak after day 30. PV NRR watch if pilot metrics miss targets.
Alex (Support): I'll open a support ticket (ONB-5219) and attach logs/diagnostic template. Maria — do they permit mirroring traffic to our staging for connector dev?
Maria (CS): Yes, customer okay with traffic mirror to staging pending signed DSA/NDA. I'll collect creds and sign-off.
Sam (Eng): For planning, we need:
```
- staging endpoint URL
- sample JSON payloads (max size)
- auth headers / token format
- expected rate limits (rps)
```
Maria (CS): I'll drop those into the kickoff doc and ping Sam when available.
deploy-bot: Reserved Dedicated pool allocation queued; will provision ~48h after infra ticket approval.
Priya (Enablement): I'll book the training sessions for Wed/Thu next week and create the short SSO video to share pre-kickoff.
Maria (CS): Proposed next steps:
1) Maria to send kickoff invite (Fri 10am PT tentative) and kickoff doc link + pre-read SSO video.
2) Alex to create support ticket and collect firewall / peering checklist.
3) Sam to triage connector tasks once sample payloads + staging info are posted.
4) Priya to publish enablement calendar invites and recordings.
5) Jess to monitor renewal signals and loop in renewals if needed.
Maria (CS): I'll run a 7-day cadence for milestones: cert exchange, peering approval, staging creds, connector POC.
Sam (Eng): Noted — will scope tasks in sprint planning once we have payloads. Could use a short PO mock endpoint for early integration tests.
Jess (Sales): Thanks — please @mention me on any timeline slips. Let's avoid >8w delay. :thumbsup:
